brett-haddoak.text: Campaign site: "California's housing shortage is real, and Santa Clarita needs to be part of the solution." Will champion mixed-use, transit-adjacent development building on Old Town Newhall, while "pushing back on reactive, developer-driven approvals that don't serve residents."
